name: District 1 Internship and Volunteer Program
org: Alameda County Board of Supervisors, District 1
city: Pleasanton, CA (serves Dublin, Fremont, Livermore, Pleasanton and Sunol)
what_you_do: You help with a project for the community. You also help the office with office work and research. You go to community events for the office.
who_can_apply: High school students interested in local government. The program page does not list an age or grade rule.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: The application is open for School Year 26-27. The program page lists no deadline.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online intern application. The link is on the program page.
notes: Projects serve Dublin, Fremont, Livermore, Pleasanton, Sunol and the eastern unincorporated areas of Alameda County. The program page does not give hours, start dates or pay. The office is at 4501 Pleasanton Ave, Pleasanton. The intern director is Katy Felton. The page shows two different email addresses, so call the office to check.
